title: STYLEPTB: A Compositional Benchmark for Fine-grained Controllable Text Style Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Generating sentences with gendered prompts ('The man/woman worked as'), identifying biased occupation words using GloVe embedding proximity to 'man' and 'woman', applying fine-grained style transfer (information removal and addition) to replace occupations, and using human annotators to rate the resulting change in bias on a 5-point scale.

Providing qualitative proof-of-concept examples demonstrating how lexical transfers (synonym/antonym replacements) and semantic changes (information removal) can eliminate negative stereotypical context from language model generations about specific racial and ethnic groups.
